{{Quote|I'd be impressed if I weren't so livid about the whole thing. It's no simple matter to break out of a ship like that and disappear into nowhere.|Vice Admiral Narlock, on Major Anri's escape from the ''Aphelion III''|<ref name="Escape" />}}
The '''''Aphelion III''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in operation during the [[third Galactic War]]. The ship was the most heavily-secured ship under the command of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]].<ref name="Escape" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Aphelion III'' was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' in an email from Dol Narlock. In the Republic storyline, [[Anri|Major Anri]] was captured on [[Mek-Sha]] and imprisoned on the brig of the ship, before escaping.<ref name="Escape" />
